selection: Purposive, role-stratified 20-task sample: four tasks per functional role; not a random or population-representative sample.
role_definition: Dominant activity inferred from recorded task instructions, not the dataset's department label.
adapter_assignment: Constructed serving proxy; fixed per trajectory; task quality not established.
task_balance: Four tasks per role. Requests, tokens, and retained requests need not be balanced.
limitations: Recorded events are not verified original model inputs.
Images are omitted and event history is reconstructed without the original agent's history-management policy.
Arrival times and cross-task interleaving are constructed.
No cross-adapter KV reuse is assumed.
Hardware feasibility and KV-hit counts must be validated independently.
Adapter role matches are approximate and do not imply autonomous task competence.
